reuse.why: Reuses the schedule's occurrences() and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the daily-skip rule is coded inline inside getNextDate instead of extending the shared weekend helper that the other weekend call sites use.

duplication.why: The inline loop re-queries occurrences one at a time, repeating the occurrence lookup just above it, and the rule will have to be copied to getUpcomingDates and schedule-template to take effect there.

placement.why: Lives in shared/schedules.ts, but inside getNextDate rather than in the weekend helper (getDateWithSkippedWeekend) that represents the weekend decision for all callers.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and a test change.

maintainability.why: A special-case branch with a hard-coded 7-attempt loop and early returns sits in getNextDate, while get-upcoming-dates and the schedule template, which apply getDateWithSkippedWeekend themselves, still move daily weekend occurrences, so the rule is inconsistent across paths.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate decides the daily weekend case itself instead of routing it through getDateWithSkippedWeekend, the helper the other weekend sites (schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates, budget/schedule-template.ts) call.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated occurrences lookup is a plain inline loop, not a disguised copy of existing logic.

one_place.where: Only shared/schedules.ts getNextDate applies the daily skip; server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts call getDateWithSkippedWeekend directly and keep moving daily weekend occurrences.
